notes.title: Heartsworn Abyss is now LIVE at Steam Next Fest 2025!
notes.notes:
Watch it on our store page:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2747810/Heartsworn_Abyss/

Feel free to drop by and say hi! :D

For the best experience, we recommend downloading Heartsworn Abyss so that you can play at your own comfy pace. Chapter 1 is FREE to play and Akari is fully voiced!

If you enjoyed Heartsworn Abyss, wishlist us to be notified when Early Access drops, and receive a cool Early Bird discount! <3

notes.title: Heartsworn Abyss: NighTmaRes Demo has been updated!
notes.notes:
Happy winter holidays, everyone!

If you haven’t played Heartsworn Abyss yet, now’s a great time to try out the demo!
We’ve added [b]tons of new voice lines[/b] for Akari and Midori, along with several small bugfixes.

What are you waiting for? Play Chapter 1 [b]FREE[/b] today. :3

notes.title: Heartsworn Abyss Demo is now live!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
